inputs.text: This is the elites panicking in plain sight. Someone's out there going on about how China and the United States teamed up to push unity and build the Paris Agreement, then getting all upset and disappointed that the US is pulling out of it again for the second time under Trump. That's the hidden powers exposing their scheme—the whole thing was cooked up by those institutions to force nations into line, and now the withdrawal is hitting their control agenda right where it hurts.
